registration: Git commit fixes this plan; no external registry submission is claimed
failures: Do not replace seeds or remove failed replicates. Any nonfinite/missing output blocks the cell from a confirmatory summary until a logged code repair and same-seed full-cell rerun.
access_boundary: No SPR, MIRA, clinical, fresh reservation, candidate response or structural score file is an analysis input.
multiplicity: One named primary estimand. All grids and additional methods are labeled sensitivity/descriptive; no search for a positive result.
reporting: Retain all cell/replicate results and failed runs; report mean, MCSE and 95% Monte Carlo intervals. Biological generalization is not inferred.
title: Coverage and power with few independent source blocks
grouping: Allocate n rows to b source blocks, sizes floor(n/b) or ceil(n/b), remainder to lowest source indices. Within each source allocate rows round-robin to min(2,source_size) receptor families. No real receptor or study identity is imported.

generator.independent_error: Same construction with independent A1,F1,R1, using the identical group layout and variances.
generator.scaling: c=sqrt(((1-effect)**2-technical_SD**2)/(1-technical_SD**2)); reject infeasible combinations, never clip radicands.
generator.observed_errors: E0=error0+technical_SD*T_row; E1=error1+technical_SD*T_row, the same technical draw for the same measured row.
generator.distributions: All A,F,R,T independent standard normals except the explicitly shared terms. Sources independent. rho_source concerns latent prediction-error variance, not observed-label ICC.
generator.truth: Population RMSE0=1 and RMSE1=1-effect, so population improvement equals effect. This is an error-level simulation, not a trained/oracle biological predictor.

point_estimate: sqrt(mean(E0**2))-sqrt(mean(E1**2)), pooled row-weighted RMSE difference; positive favors model1.

methods.source_bootstrap: Resample b source blocks with replacement, retaining every nested family and row and paired errors. Recompute pooled RMSE difference on selected rows. 1999 draws; NumPy quantile(method=linear): 2.5/97.5 percentiles for coverage, 5th percentile for the one-sided improvement rule.
methods.row_bootstrap: Same draw count, resample n paired rows ignoring blocks; explicitly a misspecified comparator, never a recommended acceptance procedure.
methods.source_swap: Enumerate all 2**b within-source swaps of the entire model0/model1 paired error vectors. One-sided p=count(permuted_delta >= observed_delta-1e-12)/2**b, including identity. Validity relies on model-label exchangeability under this synthetic null; no unverified exactness claim for biological data.

outputs: both bootstrap intervals and one-sided lower bounds
interval_reporting: Coverage, power and false-pass probabilities use Wilson 95% Monte Carlo intervals; bounded indicators are averaged over all 5000 independent datasets. Do not treat bootstrap draws as independent datasets.
mde: Smallest positive grid effect whose Wilson lower bound for power is >=0.80. Qualify a method only when its null false-pass Wilson upper bound <=0.07; bootstrap additionally requires two-sided coverage Wilson lower bound >=0.93 at null and every effect up to that grid point. Report unqualified apparent power separately. If none qualifies report >0.20 or not estimable; no interpolation or post-hoc grid extension.
quality_tolerance_note: 0.07/0.93 are predeclared 2-percentage-point methodological tolerances around 0.05/0.95, not biological benefit thresholds.
discrete_test_limit: For enumerated b blocks the smallest one-sided source-swap p is 1/2**b; b=2 or 3 cannot reject at 0.05. This arithmetic is a design constraint, not a study result.

application_gate.reason: No verified development-only repeatability/use-case basis yet fixes an actual clinical or affinity benefit threshold. Synthetic SD/effect grids are declared stress tests, not estimates from consumed tests. Real-data power mapping requires a separate amendment before new outcome access.

inference_boundary: No universal receptor-count cutoff or claim that current n=14 measured gain is proven zero. Conclusions conditional on the specified Gaussian hierarchical error generator.
stream_keys: E5 scenario excludes k, so all k share prefixes. E6 scenario excludes effect, so effects share latent draws and resampling indices. Distinct streams for labels, common/candidate scores, shadow and resampling.
mandatory_secondary: False-pass probability of one-sided 95% lower bound > 0, co-reported without replacing the primary coverage endpoint
